title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MWENEDATA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MWENEDATA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA 01368/2024/CA (Kanyange, P.J.)
28 Mutarama 2026]
Amategeko agenga ibimenyetso – Ibimenyetso mu manza Nshinjabyaha – Mu manza
nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe bigaragaza ukuri
kw’ibyabaye (principe de la liberté de la preuve en matière pénale) ababuranyi bakaba barahawe
uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye, kandi ko Urukiko arirwo rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso
bishobora kwemerwa.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Uwitwa Mwenedata yakurikiranyweho n’Ubushinjacyaha icyaha cyo
gusambanya umwana, maze nyuma y’iperereza bumuregera Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo,
busaba ko kimuhama, agahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25.
Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko uregwa ahamwa n’icyaha, rumuhanisha igifungo
cy’imyaka 20.
Uregwa nyuma yo kutishimira icyo cyemezo yajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru avuga ko Urukiko rwa
mbere rutahaye agaciro imyiregurire ye, rumuhamya icyaha rushingiye ku buhamya bw’ibinyoma,
ko ahubwo yagambaniwe n’umugabo w’aho yakoraga kubera kutishimira ko we n’umwana we
baba iwe.
Urukiko Rukuru rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko hari ibimenyetso simusiga bigaragaza ko
yasambanyije umwana, rwemeza ko hagumaho igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri (20)
yahanishijwe.
Mwenedata yajuririye mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko Urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha rushingiye
ku bimenyetso birimo kugenekereza no gushidikanya.
Ubushinjacyaha ku rundi ruhande buvuga ko ubujurire nta shingiro bukwiye guhabwa, kuko nta
kugenekereza cyangwa gushidikanya biri mu bimenyetso byashingiweho mu kumuhamya icyaha,
ko ahubwo hagumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Mu manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu
gihe bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye (principe de la liberté de la preuve en matière pénale)
ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye, kandi ko Urukiko arirwo
rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso bishobora kwemerwa.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko N° 15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo,
Ingingo ya 119.
Imanza zifashishijwe:

RPAA 00692/2021/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Ndayishimiye Jean Damascène rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023;
RPAA 00080/2025/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Sindikubwabo Etienne rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 29/12/2025.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Mwenedata Julien yaketsweho gusambanya umwana we w’imyaka 14 y’amavuko witwa
U.L.1, biturutse k’uwitwa Sindikubwabo Célestin wavuze ko ubwo ku wa 30/09/2020 uwitwa
Ribakare Anaclet yamutumaga mu rugo iwe aho Mwenedata Julien yakoraga akaba ari naho U.L.
yabaga, yinjiye mu nzu abona Mwenedata Julien ari mu cyumba cy’abana yamanuye ipantaro
ayigeza ku maguru ari hejuru ya U.L. arimo kumusambanya nawe arimo kurira, ababajije ibyo
barimo Mwenedata Julien atangira kuganiriza uwo mwana amubwira ngo ntazongere gukubita
abandi bana, ahita abakingirana ajya kubimenyesha abaturanyi, Mwenedata Julien atangira
gukurikiranwa.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwamureze mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo
icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, bushingiye ku bimenyetso bigizwe n’imvugo z’uwo mwana, iza
Sindikubwabo Célestin na raporo ya muganga, bumusabira guhanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25.
[3] Mwenedata Julien yaburanye ahakana icyaha, avuga ko
atasambanyije umwana we ahubwo ko Sindikubwabo Célestin yasanze arimo kumubaza impamvu
atakoze imirimo yari yamuhaye, ko nta kimenyetso cy’uko yamusanze hejuru y’uwo mwana.
[4] Mu rubanza RP 01552/2020/TGI/GSBO rwaciwe ku wa 24/02/2021, Urukiko rwasanze
Mwenedata Julien yarakoze icyaha akurikiranweho kuko hari ibimenyetso bikimushinja, bigizwe
n’imvugo z’umwana we umushinja, ubuhamya bwa Sindikubwabo Célestin wasobanuye ko
yinjiye mu nzu akamusanga hejuru y’uwo mwana arimo kumusambanya no kuba Mwenedata
Julien yaravuze ko ubwo yari ari kumwe n’uwo mwana mu nzu Sindikubwabo Célestin amaze
kubakingirana, yumvise abantu agaca mu idirishya. Rwemeje rero ko ahamwa n’icyaha cyo
gusambanya umwana, rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri (20).
[5] Mwenedata Julien yajuriye mu Rukiko Rukuru, avuga ko Urukiko rwa mbere rutahaye
agaciro imyiregurire ye, rumuhamya icyaha rushingiye ku buhamya bw’ibinyoma, ko ahubwo
yagambaniwe n’umugabo w’aho yakoraga kubera kutishimira ko we n’umwana we baba iwe.
[6] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ko impamvu z’ubujurire bwe nta shingiro zifite, kuko ntacyo
apfa n’umutangabuhamya wamubonye ari hejuru y’umwana we arimo kumusambanya, ko na
raporo ya muganga yagaragaje ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe.
[7] Mu rubanza RPA 00576/2021/HC/KIG rwaciwe ku wa 22/11/2024, Urukiko Rukuru narw
rwasanze hari ibimenyetso bihamya ko Mwenedata Julien yakoze icyaha akurikiranweho, bigizwe
1 Yahawe iri zina kuko ari umwana.

n’imvugo z’umwana we wasobanuye ko yamujyanye mu nzu akamusambanya, akamuvaho ari
uko Sindikubwabo Célestin ababonye akabakingirana, se agaca mu idirishya, bigashimangirwa
n’imvugo za Sindikubwabo Célestin wavuze uko yabonye Mwenedata Julien ari hejuru y’umwana
we arimo kumusambanya akabakingirana mu nzu, bikanashimangirwa kandi na raporo ya
muganga igaragaza ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe.
[8] Rwasobanuye ko imvugo ya Mwenedata Julien y’uko yagambaniwe na Ribakare Anaclet
yakoreraga kuko atashakaga ko we n’umwana we baba iwe, nta shingiro bifite, kuko bari bahabaye
imyaka 3 nta kibazo bafitanye, kugeza ubwo Sindikubwabo Célestin asanze arimo gusambanya
uwo mwana ndetse n’uwo mwana akabyemeza, kandi ko imvugo umwana yakoresheje asobanura
uko byagenze igaragaza ko atari ubwa mbere yari amusambanyije, nk’aho yavuze ko se
yamubwiye ngo yihangane kuko gushaka umugore byamunaniye. Rwasanze kandi adakwiye
kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano kuko yakigabanyirijwe bihagije, maze rwemeza ko hagumaho
igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri (20) yahanishijwe.
[9] Mwenedata Julien yajuriye mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza ruhabwa RPAA
01368/2024/CA, iburanisha ribera mu ruhame ku wa 02/12/2025 Mwenedata Julien yunganirwa
na Me Musasangohe Illuminée, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Niyonkuru Françoise,
Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu.
[10] Urubanza rwongeye kuburanishwa ku wa 08/01/2026 kugira ngo humvwe abantu
batumijwe hashingiwe ku cyemezo rwafashe ku wa 29/12/2025, aribo Nyituriki Cacirina,
Sindikubwabo Célestin na U.L., ruburanishwa Mwenedata Julien yunganiwe nka mbere naho
Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Rukaka Gallican, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu, naho
abatangabuhamya nta n’umwe witabye kandi nta mpamvu batanze n’ubwo bari bagejejweho
inyandiko zibatumiza, usibye U.L. utarabonetse aho yabarizwaga, bituma Urukiko rufata
icyemezo cyo gupfundikira iburanisha hakazashingirwa ku bimenyetso bisanzwe muri dosiye.
[11] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire no mu miburanire, Mwenedata Julien n’umwunganira bavuga
ko yajurijwe n’uko Urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha rushingiye ku bimenyetso birimo kugenekereza
no gushidikanya.
[12] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite, kuko nta
kugenekereza cyangwa gushidikanya biri mu bimenyetso byashingiweho mu kumuhamya icyaha,
ko ahubwo hagumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.
[13] Ikibazo kigomba gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza n’icyo kumenya niba Mwenedata Julien
yarahamijwe icyaha hashigiwe ku bimenyetso birimo kugenekereza no gushidikanya.
II. ISESENGURA RY’IKIBAZO KIRI MU RUBANZA
Kumenya niba Mwenedata Julien yarahamijwe icyaha hashigiwe ku bimenyetso birimo
kugenekereza no gushidikanya.
[14] Mwenedata Julien n’umwunganira bavuga ko Urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha rushingiye ku
bimenyetso birimo kugenekereza no gushidikanya, kuko mu ibazwa rya U.L. yabanje kuvuga ko
ntacyo se yamutwaye, nyuma avuga ko yamwinjijemo igitsina akababara akanarira, ko izo mvugo

ze hamwe n’iza Sindikubwabo Célestin wavuze ko yasanze Mwenedata Julien hejuru y’uwo
mwana amusambanya zishidikanywaho, kubera ko zivuguruzwa na raporo ya muganga yagaragaje
ko nta kimenyetso cyo gusambanywa cya vuba cyabonetse kuri uwo mwana, kandi ko iyo hajya
kubaho kwinjiza igitsina mu cy’uwo mwana, muganga aba yarabibonye, no kuba muganga
yarashingiye ku byo yabwiwe n’umwana akavuga ko se ajya amusambanya ari inenge iri muri iyo
raporo, ko kandi icyaciye akarangabusugi k’uwo mwana se atakimenya, kubera ingeso yari afite
zo kugenda agata urugo, naho ibivugwa n’Ubushinjacyaha ko Sindikubwabo yasanze ariho
bagitangira (gusambana) bikaba bitashingirwaho kuko byaba ari ukugenekereza, ndetse
Mwenedata Julien nawe akaba atarapimwe kandi yarabisabye agifatwa.
[15] Basobanura ko ibyo bamushinja ko yasambanyije umwana we, byabanjirijwe n’uko hari
igihe nyiri urugo babagamo witwa Ribakare Anaclet yatashye agasanga hakinze U.L. yataye
urugo, bamuregera se ngo azamuhane, bitewe n’uko yari yakoreye hafi, aboneraho kumucyaha
amukubita n’urushyi, amaze kumukubita yirukira mu cyumba, amukurikirayo agiye kumubaza
impamvu z’iyo myitwarire, ko rero yarizwaga n’uko se yari amaze kumukubita, akaba
kandi yari afitanye agakungu na Sindikubwabo Célestin. Basanga rero
imvugo z’uwo mwana zitaragombaga gushingirwaho kuko ibyo yavuze yabitewe n’uko se
yari yamukubise, cyane cyane ko bitanumvikana uburyo yari kujya gusambanya umwana ngo
asige imiryango yose ikinguye.
[16] Bavuga ko Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rwakosora ayo makosa, hashingiwe ku biteganywa
n’ingingo ya 4 y’Itegeko N° 068/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri
rusange2 hamwe n’ingingo ya 111 y’Itegeko N°027/2019 ryo ku wa 19/09/2019 ryerekeye
imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha3, no ku mirongo yatanzwe mu manza zaciwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, aho abaregwa bagizwe abere kubera gushidikanya4, Mwenedata Julien
nawe akagirwa umwere.
[17] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ibyo Mwenedata Julien ashingiraho ubujurire bwe
nta shingiro bifite, kuko U.L. yasobanuye uburyo se yamusambanyije, kandi imvugo ze zikaba
zigomba guhabwa agaciro nk’uko Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwabisobanuye mu rubanza
RPAA0012/08/CS rwaciwe ku wa 26/22/2010 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Hakizimana Servilien
na Sibomana, rusobanura ko bitabujijwe ko uwahohotewe atanga ibisobanuro bijyanye n’icyaha.
[18] Avuga ko hari na raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe, kuko
akarangabusugi ke kangiritse n’ubwo muri iyo raporo bivugwa ko bitari iby’ako kanya, kuko
Sindikubwabo Célestin yamutesheje bitewe n’uko yahageze Mwenedata Julien akava hejuru
y’uwo mwana, nyamara umwana akaba yaravuze ko itari inshuro ya mbere amusambanya, kandi
uwo munsi akaba yarafashwe amuri hejuru arimo kumusambanya, uwo mwana kandi akaba ntacyo
2 Iyo ngingo iteganya ko: “Amategeko ahana agomba gufatwa uko ateye, ntashobora gukoreshwa ku buryo
butandukira. Inkiko zibujijwe guca imanza ku buryo bugenekereje”.
3 Iyo ngingo iteganya ko: “gushidikanya birengera ushinjwa. Iyo urubanza rwakurikiranywe mu buryo bwose,
ntihagire ibimenyetso nyakuri biboneka byemeza nta shiti abacamanza ko ushinjwa yakoze icyaha koko, bagomba
kwemeza ko atsinze”.
4 Bavuga urubanza N°RPAA 00307/2022/CA rwaciwe ku wa 27/12/2024, haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na NYANDWI Emmanuel alias Kaguru n’urubanza N°RPAA 00397/2024/CA rwaciwe ku wa
27/12/2024 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na MURENGEZI.

yapfaga na se cyatuma amubeshyera, ko ahubwo se yamubwiraga ko kuba nta mugore afite, ibyo
yakamukoreye azajya abikorera uwo mwana, bityo ko nta kugenekereza no gushidikanya biri mu
rubanza rujuririrwa.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[19] Impaka muri uru rubanza zishingiye ku kumenya niba Mwenedata Julien yarahamijwe
icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana hashigiwe ku bimenyetso birimo kugenekereza no gushidikanya.
[20] Ku birebana n’ibimenyetso mu manza, mu rubanza RPAA 00692/2021/CA rwaciwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Ndayishimiye Jean
Damascène, hasesenguwe ingingo ya 119 y’Itegeko N° 15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye
ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo5, harebwe cyane cyane ku mwihariko w’imanza
nshinjabyaha, maze Urukiko rusobanura ko mu manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora
gushingirwaho mu gihe bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye (principe de la liberté de la preuve en
matière pénale) ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye, kandi ko
Urukiko arirwo rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso bishobora kwemerwa. Iri hame ryashingiweho mu
zindi manza zakurikiyeho zaciwe n’uru Rukiko, urwaciwe bwa nyuma akaba ari urubanza RPAA
00080/2025/CA, rwaciwe ku wa 29/12/2025, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Sindikubwabo Etienne.
[21] Nk’uko urubanza rwajuririwe rubigaragaza, Mwenedata Julien yahamijwe icyaha
hashingiwe ku mvugo z’umwana we U.L. wamushinje kumusambanya, ku buhamya bwa
Sindikubwabo Célestin wavuze ko yamusanze hejuru y’uwo mwana arimo kumusambanya no kuri
raporo ya muganga.
[22] Mu birebana na U.L., mu nyandikomvugo yakorewe mu Bugenzacyaha ku wa 30/09/2020,
yasobanuye ko uwo munsi (30/09/2020), se yari yaje guhinga kwa Ribakare Anaclet amusanga
mu rugo ari wenyine aramubwira ngo namuhe kuko kwihangana byamunaniye, yanze
aramukurura amujyana mu cyumba, atangira kurira, amusunikira ku gitanda azamura ijipo ye
amanura n’ikariso, abanza kuyifata ariko amurusha imbaraga, nawe amanura ipantaro ayigeza
hepfo amujya hejuru, amushyiramo igitsina nawe akomeza kurira, hinjira umuhungu bari
batumye asanga amuri hejuru ahita amuvaho, uwo muhungu asiga abakingiranye maze se anyura
mu idirishya nawe aramukingurira arasohoka. Yanasobanuye ko se yamusambanyije inshuro
nyinshi bakibana bonyine ubwo yabaga yatashye yasinze, akajya avuga ngo yihangane kuko
gushaka undi mugore byamunaniye, ariko ko ntawe yigeze abibwira, ko no kuba yarabanje kuvuga
ko ntacyo se yamutwaye byatewe n’uko yari yamubwiye ko nabivuga babafunga bombi.
[23] Naho mu buhamya bwa Sindikubwabo Célestin, yasobanuye ko ku wa 30/09/2020
Ribakare Anaclet yamutumye iwe mu rugo, ahageze yinjira mu nzu akomeza ajya mu cyumba
kureba ibyo bari bamutumye, anyuze ku cyumba abana bararamo abonamo umugabo wamanuye
ipantaro ayigeza ku maguru n’umwana aryamye agaramye uwo mugabo amuri hejuru akajipo ke
yakazamuye naho umwana arimo kurira, ababajije ibyo barimo Mwenedata Julien ahita atangira
kuganiriza uwo mwana amubwira ngo ntazongere gukubita undi mwana, ariko ko atitaye ku byo
yavugaga kuko yari amaze kubona ibyo arimo ahubwo yahise asohoka arabakingirana ajya
kubimenyesha abaturanyi, Mwenedata Julien ahita anyura mu idirishya arasohoka akingurira uwo
5 Iyo ngingo ihura n’ingingo ya 87 y’Itegeko Nº 062/2024 ryo ku wa 20/06/2024 rigenga ibimenyetso.

mwana nawe arasohoka, akomeza gukora akazi yari arimo, ko kandi atari asanzwe amuzi kuko
yamubonye gusa muri icyo gitondo, kuko nawe yari umushyitsi muri urwo rugo.
[24] Naho mu nyandikomvugo ya Mwenedata Julien yakoreye mu Bugenzacyaha ku wa
30/09/2020, yavuze ko uwo munsi yaje kwa Ribakare Anaclet kubahingira ahagera saa moya za
mu gitondo ahava saa sita, asubirayo saa saba, ko muri urwo rugo hari hariyo umwana we U.L.
n’undi mwana wa Anaclet muto ariko we akaba yari yamutumye kuvoma, ko ubwo yari ari kumwe
na U.L. mu nzu umuntu yabasanzemo ababaza ibyo barimo, yumva nta mpamvu yo kumuha
ibisobanuro ahita asohoka, ariko ko atemera ibyo yavuze ko yasanze ari hejuru y’uwo mwana, ko
ahubwo yasanze yicaye ku buriri, umwana aryamye arimo kurira kuko yari maze kumukubita
urushyi bitewe n’uko yari yamusuzuguye ashaka kujya kuvoma kandi yari yatumyeyo undi
mwana, akaba ari uko yasanze bameze, asohotse arabakingirana, anyura mu idirishya arakingura;
ko iby’uko umwana yaba yaravuze ko yamusambanyije ari ukumubeshyera, ho ahubwo ashobora
kuba yaratinye abayobozi, kandi ko uwo Sindikubwabo nta cyo bapfa, ko ari n’ubwa mbere yari
amubonye.
[25] Ku birebana na raporo ya muganga, igaragaza ko U.L. yasuzumwe ku wa 01/10/2020, mu
byo yagaragaje hakaba harimo ko akarangabusugi ke kari gahari ariko ko hari aho kacitse (hymen
présent avec quelques déchirures), naho mu mwanzuro ikavuga ko nta kimenyetso cy’uko uwo
mwana yasambanyijwe mu gihe cya vuba, ariko ko hakurikijwe ubuhamya, yagiye asambanywa
na se (pas de signes de rapport recent, mais selon le témoignage elle a de rapport sexuel occasionnel
avec son père), kandi ko nta burwayi bwandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina yari afite.
[26] Ku bivugwa na Mwenedata Julien n’umwunganira ko imvugo za U.L. zishidikanywaho
ngo kuko yabanje kuvuga ko ntacyo se yamutwaye, nyuma akavuga ko yamusambanyije, Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire rurasanga nta shingiro bifite, kuko n’ubwo bigaragara ko mu nyandikomvugo ye
yabajijwe impamvu yabanje kuvuga ko ntacyo se yamutwaye, yarasobanuye ko byatewe n’uko se
yari yamubwiye ko babafunga bombi, kandi uretse ibyo akaba yarasobanuye uko yamusambanyije
kandi ko yagiye amusambanya kenshi. Bigaragara kandi ko uburyo yasobanuye uko ibintu
byagenze ku munsi wo ku wa 30/09/2020, bihura n’ibyo Sindikubwabo Célestin yasobanuye,
kuko bombi bahuriza ku kuba uyu yarasanze U.L. ari mu cyumba na se, umwana aryamye naho se
yamanuye ipantaro, amuri hejuru arimo kumusambanya, bakanahuriza ku kuba yarasize
abakingiranye,ndetse hakaba hari ibyo abo bombi bahurizaho na Mwenedata, nko kuba nawe
yaremeye ko Sindikubwabo yamusanze mu cyumba ari kumwe na U.L, uyu aryamye arimo kurira,
no kuba uwo mutangabuhamya yarasize abakingiranye, ndetse Mwenedata n’uwo
mutangabuhamya bagahuriza ku kuba uyu akibabona yarabajije ibyo bari barimo, bivuze ko
yabonaga hari ibyo bari gukora, uko guhuza ku bintu bitandukanye bikaba byumvikanisha ko nta
gushidikanya kuri mu mvugo z’uwo mwana, cyane cyane ko nta mpamvu yigeze atanga yari
gutuma uwo mwana amubeshyera.
[27] Na none ibivugwa na Mwenedata Julien n’umwunganira ko imvugo z’uwo mwana
zitagombaga gushingirwaho ngo kuko ibyo yavuze yabitewe n’uko yari yamukubise, Urukiko
rurasanga nabyo nta gaciro byahabwa, kuko ibyo kuba yarakubise ntaho uwo mwana yigeze
abivuga mu nyandikomvugo ye. Byongeye kandi harebwe uburyo Mwenedata yagiye asobanura
ibintu, bigaragara ko nta kumukubita byabayeho harebwe ko yagiye abitangira impamvu
zitandukanye, kuko mu Bugenzacyaha yavuze ko byatewe n’uko yari yamusuzuguye ashaka kujya
kuvoma kandi yari yatumyeyo undi mwana, mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye avuga ko yamuhoye ko

atakoze ibyo yamusabye gukora ahubwo akigira kuvoma asize ibintu hanze, naho mu Rukiko
Rukuru avuga ko bamumuregeye ko asigaye agenda agatwara urufunguzo bigatuma nyirabuja
bamukubita, bituma amukubita yirukira mu nzu amusangayo ngo amusobanurire iby’ayo makosa
aribwo Sindukubwabo yaje agakinga. Urukiko rurasanga rero, kuvuga izo mpamvu zitandukanye
byumvikanisha ko ari uburyo bwo gushaka gusobanura impamvu uwo mutangabuhamya
yamusanze mu cyumba ari kumwe n’uwo mwana kandi uyu arimo kurira, ibyo kuba yarimo arira
bikaba byaranemejwe n’uwo mwana, Sindikubwabo ndetse na Mwenedata.
[28] Ku bivugwa na Mwenedata, ko U.L. yari afitanye agakungu na Sindikubwabo Célestin,
Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga nta gaciro byahabwa, kuko mu nyandikomvugo ye (Mwenedata)
yo mu Bugenzacyaha, yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere yari abonye Sindikubwabo Célestin ko kandi
ntacyo bapfaga, mu gihe iyo aza kuba asanganwe agakungu n’umwana we, yari kuba
yaramubonye, ndetse na Sindikubwabo Célestin akaba yaravuze ko bwari ubwa mbere yari abonye
Mwenedata Julien ko kandi atari azi ko ari we se w’uwo mwana.
[29] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga kandi ibyo bavuga ko imvugo z’uwo mwana n’iza
Sindikubwabo Célestin zivuguruzanya na raporo ya muganga, nta shingiro bifite, kuko kuba
muganga yarasanze nta kimenyetso cya vuba kigaragara kuri uwo mwana bitavuze ko
atamusambanyije, cyane cyane ko atahise asuzumwa ahubwo yasuzumwe ku munsi wakurikiyeho,
bikaba byumvikana ko hari ibimenyetso bitari bikimuriho, bikaba ndetse byanahuzwa n’uburyo
icyaha cyakozwemo, kuko umwana yasobanuye ko se amaze gushyira igitsina mu cye,
Sindikubwabo yahise yinjira ahita amuvaho. Byongeye kandi kuba iyo raporo yaragaragaje ko hari
aho akarangabusugi kagiye gacika, byahuzwa n’uko uwo mwana yavuze ko se yagiye
amusambanya mu bihe bitandukanye,
[30] Hashingiwe rero ku byasobanuwe, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga impamvu z’ubujurire
bwa Mwenedata Julien nta shingiro zifite, kuko ibimenyetso byashingiweho bidashidikanywaho
ahubwo bimuhamya icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana nk’uko inkiko za mbere zakimuhamije,
bityo hakaba hagumyeho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe n’igihano yahanishijwe.
